mission.title: Shakedown
mission.description: Squeeze the Merovingian's and the Machines' operatives for word on where the General's key has gone.

phase.briefing:
So I get us a good lead, and Tyndall goes and blows it, huh? I see how things work around here. I get no credit, man. Tyndall has Lock wrapped around her finger.
Whatever. I'm used to it. As usual, it's up to Anome to get us out of this reeking mess we've landed in.
We may not have much information on the key...but I bet you someone else does. Let's go "persuade" some Mervs to spill their guts, eh?

enter.say: Intel said we'd find some Merv redpills in there...and I'm scanning some reds, all right. Stick it to 'em.

objective.text: Search the hideout for a lead on the key

done.say: Aarhus, huh? We'll have to get Anome to run a check on that name.

phase.briefing: See? I get results. Intel ran a check on "Aarhus," and came up with a probable location based on known records. You know what to do when you find her. She'll talk... Oh yes, she'll talk...

enter.say: I've got redpill signals in there. Uh... Do you know what to do when you find Aarhus? I swear, I think Anome has torture scenes playing in his head.

talk.say: So, you want to know about us arranging to get the key from Silver? Hah, you'll get nothing out of me!

done.say: Silver? If that sociopathic nutball really has the key, we could have a big problem on our hands. We'd better tell Anome.

phase.briefing:
Silver, huh? I've always liked that guy's style...
If the Mervs are going to get the key from Silver, then he must be hiding it somewhere. The question is, where? The Mervs wouldn't know, but maybe the Machines would. Ah Anome, you're so devious!
I'm sending you after some low-ranking Machine operatives this time. We can't attack them directly--damn Truce--so pretend that you're there to check up on how the key operation is proceeding, and we'll see what they say.

enter.say: I've got a few redpill signals in there. Showtime...

talk.say: Damn it! I mean, sir, damn it, sir! My "fellow" operative here is always interrupting me!
Sorry for the annoyance, sir! My "partner" here is a little slow!

done.say: Efimov is running the operation, eh? That code the other one gave is a Machine reference address. I should be able to have it converted into a nice friendly coordinate address by the time you get outside.

phase.briefing:
Hah, I knew they'd fall for it. I've been getting good info from those two slow-jacks for months now.
Get to this Efimov guy and find out what he knows about the key. We're not supposed to attack the Machines, but hey, that just means you can't leave any witnesses, right? Besides, redpills aren't really Machines anyway, if you ask me.

enter.say: I've got redpill signals in there.
I don't know what you think you're doing here, but I can't let you live.

done.say: That takes care of all the Machine operatives in the area.
A construct? The Machines are searching for the key in a construct... Would Silver have access to one of those?

mission.finish:
A construct. Of course. I wonder why it took the Machines so long to figure that out.
So let's see... Silver has the key... Going to trade it to the Mervs... The Machines think the key is in a construct... Oh yeah, I know where this is headed. Hah! Lock better promote me for this.
